data.case_title: Glanzwerk Beispielputz – Cleaning subscription contract confirmation
data.title: Cleaning subscription contract confirmation – Glanzwerk Beispielputz
data.summary: Glanzwerk Beispielputz GmbH confirms a household cleaning subscription (Haushaltsreinigung im Abo) that Timo Beispielneckar signed up for on 21 November 2026 at a sales booth, starting 7 January 2027 at €119.00 per month. The letter also informs him of his 14-day right of withdrawal (Widerruf) from the contract.
data.explanation: This is a confirmation of a cleaning subscription you agreed to at a sales booth. Because the contract was concluded outside the company's regular business premises, German law gives you 14 days from signing to withdraw (Widerruf) without giving a reason, simply by sending a clear statement to the company. You may decide whether to keep or cancel the subscription, and the app shows until when you can still withdraw. If you do nothing, the subscription starts on 7 January 2027 at €119.00 per month. Any money already paid would be refunded within 14 days of a withdrawal.
data.tax_note: Household cleaning services (haushaltsnahe Dienstleistungen) can qualify for a tax reduction under §35a EStG (20% of the labour cost, up to a yearly limit) on the German income tax return, so the payment receipts for this subscription may be worth keeping.

items.title: Decide whether to withdraw from the cleaning subscription (Widerruf)
items.action: If you no longer want the subscription, send a clear withdrawal statement to Glanzwerk Beispielputz GmbH (by post or to abo@glanzwerk-beispielputz.example) by the deadline shown; you may use the enclosed withdrawal form.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, you lose the right to withdraw from the contract without giving a reason and the subscription will proceed as agreed.

date.text: Innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Vertragsschluss können Sie sich ohne Begründung wieder von diesem Vertrag lösen, indem Sie ihn widerrufen.
